securityInvariants.staff: JWT verification + active organization membership + request-scoped database session + forced PostgreSQL RLS
securityInvariants.customer: single-use access redemption + customer-scoped portal session + organization/customer scope + forced PostgreSQL RLS
securityInvariants.refreshRule: A mutation is not certified until the owning screen reloads or invalidates/refetches the authoritative resource and displays the returned state.

journeys.name: Athena recommendation to approved domain action
